24/**
25 * @brief Construct a @ref Quaternion from roll-pitch-yaw (RPY) Euler angles.
26 *
27 * @param[in] rpy Roll (X), pitch (Y), and yaw (Z) angles [rad].
28 * @return The resulting @ref Quaternion (ZYX intrinsic rotation order).
29 *
30 * @note This function only exists to make editing rotations in SuperDex Studio user-friendly and
31 * to resolve imported RPY rotations (e.g. from URDF). Prefer quaternion math for all other
32 * applications.
33 */
34[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API Quaternion QuaternionFromRPY(Real3 const& rpy);
35
36/**
37 * @brief Extract roll-pitch-yaw (RPY) Euler angles from a @ref Quaternion.
38 *
39 * @param[in] q The quaternion to decompose.
40 * @return Roll (X), pitch (Y), and yaw (Z) angles [rad].
41 *
42 * @note This function only exists to make editing rotations in SuperDex Studio user-friendly and
43 * to resolve imported RPY rotations (e.g. from URDF). Prefer quaternion math for all other
44 * applications.
45 */
46[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API Real3 RPYFromQuaternion(Quaternion const& q);

48/**
49 * @brief Dot product that treats 0 * inf as 0, avoiding IEEE 754 NaN.
50 *
51 * @details Standard @ref Dot produces NaN when one operand has ±inf in a component where the other
52 * operand is zero (e.g. Dot({-inf, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 1}) = NaN + 0 + 0 = NaN). This variant skips
53 * terms where either factor is zero.
54 *
55 * @param[in] a First operand.
56 * @param[in] b Second operand.
57 * @return Dot product with 0 * inf treated as 0.
58 */
59[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API real SafeDot(Real3 const& a, Real3 const& b);
60
61/**
62 * @brief Scale a vector by a scalar, treating 0 * inf as 0 to avoid IEEE 754 NaN.
63 *
64 * @details Standard multiplication produces NaN when a zero vector component is scaled by ±inf
65 * (e.g. {0, 0, 1} * -inf = {NaN, NaN, -inf}). This variant preserves zero components.
66 *
67 * @param[in] v Vector to scale.
68 * @param[in] scalar Scalar factor.
69 * @return Scaled vector with zero components preserved.
70 */
71[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API Real3 SafeScale(Real3 const& v, real scalar);
